description: Try 26 utility REST APIs keylessly: NAICS classification, IP geo, email validation, currency.
summary: Try 26 utility REST APIs keylessly: NAICS classification, IP geo, email validation, currency.
offersHint: Try 26 utility REST APIs keylessly: NAICS classification, IP geo, email validation, currency. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://abundanceapis.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: list_apis
toolsPreview.description: List the full Abundance APIs catalog — every API with its description, category, OpenAPI spec URL, RapidAPI listing URL, gateway host, and pricing. Call this first to discover what is available and how to get production access.

toolsPreview.name: naics_match
toolsPreview.description: Semantically match a plain-English company description to 2022 NAICS industry codes. Returns ranked codes with a 0-100 match rating, hierarchy, and the official Census activities that matched. Keyless trial of the NAICS Code Finder API.

toolsPreview.name: ip_lookup
toolsPreview.description: Geolocate an IPv4/IPv6 address — country, city, coordinates, timezone. Keyless trial of the IP Geolocation API.

toolsPreview.name: email_validate
toolsPreview.description: Validate an email address — syntax, MX records, disposable/role detection, and typo suggestions. Keyless trial of the Email Validator API.

toolsPreview.name: currency_convert
toolsPreview.description: Convert an amount between currencies using European Central Bank daily reference rates. Keyless trial of the Currency Exchange Rates API.

toolsPreview.name: url_metadata
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a URL's Open Graph / Twitter card metadata (title, description, preview image) server-side. Keyless trial of the Web Toolbox API.

toolsPreview.name: cors_fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch any URL through the SSRF-hardened CORS proxy and return its response headers + status. Keyless trial of the CORS Proxy & Web Toolbox API.
